name: Xperia Z1 Compact

images.credit: Skeptikus One, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Announced / released: 2013-12-19 (SO-02F/Sony Xperia Z1 f variant), 2014-01-24 (Sony Xperia Z1 Compact)
Launch.Predecessor: Sony Xperia ZR, Sony Xperia A (Japan), Sony Xperia SX (Japan)
Launch.Successor: Sony Xperia Z3 Compact (Global), Sony Xperia A2 (Japan), Sony Xperia J1 Compact (Japan)

Body.Dimensions: 127 mm H , 64.9 mm W , 9.5 mm D
Body.Other: Available in white, black, pink and lime, IP55 / IP58 (Dust protected, Water jet protected & Waterproof), Magnetic charge port, PlayStation App, TrackID, 4k video playback support, Osaifu-Keitai (SO-02F variant only), 1seg (SO-02F variant only), NOTTV (SO-02F variant only), POBox Touch 6.2 (SO-02F variant only)

Platform.Operating system: Android 4.3 Jelly Bean (launch) , Android 4.4.4 KitKat , Android 5.0.2 Lollipop , Android 5.1.1 Lollipop
Platform.CPU: 2.2 GHz quad-core Krait 400 (2.2 GHz Qualcomm MSM8974 Quad Core)

Display.Display: 4.3 in diagonal IPS LCD, 720x1280 px (342 PPI), 515 cd/m2

Cameras.Rear camera: Sony G Lens 20.7 MP 1/2.3" Exmor RS IMX220 back-side illuminated sensor with BIONZ™ Engine for mobile image processor and LED flash, 1080p video recording @ 30 frames/s, 720p video recording @ 30 frames/s, VIA root access, 2160p video recording @ 30 frames/s, 1080p video recording @ 60 frames/s (Exclusive to Android 5.0.2), 720p video recording @ 120 frames/s

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi, DLNA, GPS/GLONASS, NFC, Bluetooth 4.0, ANT+
